title: Goofy Ahh Car Horn
blurb: The goofy ahh car horn — a horn that has no business sounding like this. Where a normal horn communicates warning, this one communicates circus. It's the designated sound for clownish arrivals and departures: play it when someone shows up late with iced coffee, or leaves the group chat after starting drama. Beep beep, but make it disrespectful.
origin: From the goofy ahh meme genre — vehicle horns included.
